verdicts.reason: do_early_exception fixes page tables or delegates to VC/VE/fixup handlers; idt_setup_early_traps and idt_setup_traps populate idt_table and load IDT.
Fragments show IRQ and IPI/thermal sysvec handlers, but do not show per-CPU dispatch tables or MSI sysvec coverage.
early_ignore_irq halts on recursion when CONFIG_PRINTK is set; hpet_clkevt_set_next_event returns -ETIME if target is < HPET_MIN_CYCLES away (caller retries). ich_force_hpet_resume is unrelated.
smp_read_mpc aborts loop on unknown MP type and logs pr_err if no CPUs registered; ELCR_trigger just reads PIC_ELCR1 without showing a narrow fallback policy.

overall: Finding 5 is fully supported by the cited initialization and exception routines; Findings 6, 7, and 8 are partially supported because cited fragments omit per-CPU/MSI details, retry loops, or fallback bounds.
